verdict.rationale: Quo documents some built-in behaviors that run without a human present. Sona answers calls when the team can't and captures details (quo-docs-22). Recorded calls are automatically transcribed and summarized, with AI call tags applied (quo-docs-23, quo-docs-27). Rule-based routing, ring orders and phone menus are also offered (quo-docs-21, quo-docs-26). The MCP server and API are developer building blocks and earn no credit; nothing shows a user-defined automation or workflow builder. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable automation builder (triggers, conditions, actions), scheduled or recurring autonomous tasks, detail on how Sona is configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
